repos_data.description: A Python package and CLI for parsing aggregate and forensic DMARC reports
Rust MCP server with 168 security tools for Claude — DNS/DNSSEC, TLS, email security, OSINT, threat intelligence, supply chain & cloud. 0 API keys.
Tiny Go client for Postmark's SpamCheck API: submit a raw email, get its SpamAssassin spam score and matched-rule breakdown. No account or API key required.
MCP server for IntoDNS.ai — free DNS, DMARC, SPF, DKIM, BIMI, MTA-STS, DNSSEC & email security checks for Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT and other AI agents. No API key required.
DNS Doctor MCP server and Claude Code plugin: scan, fix and verify a domain's DNS, SPF, DMARC and DKIM from any AI agent.
Security-first MCP server for SendGrid — recipient allowlists, send caps, review-mode, audit log, no silent BCC. Hardened against the postmark-mcp incident class.

Email MCP server / email operating system for AI agents: two-axis triage (importance x urgency), a Right Now lane, commitment follow-through, reviewable drafts, and a machine-verifiable BEC hard-stop (money/banking-change/first-contact = human-only). Zero-auth sandbox; the hosted tier never sends mail (local send is opt-in, off by default).
